```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Runs daily at 02:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:    # Allows manual trigger

jobs:
  abuse-detection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write   # Needed for committing changes
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run abuse detection
        id: abuse
        run: |
          set -e
          npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts --last 24h --parallel 3 --auto-apply > abuse_output.txt
          echo "output=$(cat abuse_output.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit changes if any
        run: |
          git config user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            git add .
            git commit -m "Apply abuse blocks"
            git push
          else
            echo "No changes to commit"
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post to Slack
        uses: tokorom/action-slack-incoming-webhook@d57bf1eb618f3dae9509afefa70d5774ad3d42bf
        with:
          text: |
            Abuse detection cron run completed.
            Output:
            ${{ steps.abuse.outputs.output }}
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
